Download **UniFiles-Setup-x.x.x.exe** from the Assets below and run it.

- Drop in images, videos, audio, documents and spreadsheets (or a whole folder) and convert them all at once
- Pick a format per file, or set every image / video / etc. in one click
- Images ↔ JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO, PDF (combine many images into one PDF)
- Videos ↔ MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV, AVI, GIF, or extract the audio
- PDF → Word, TXT or page images · Word → PDF · TXT/Markdown → PDF or Word
- PDF tools: extract, remove, split, rotate and merge pages without losing text or quality, with clickable page previews
- Ebooks: EPUB and FB2 → PDF, Word, TXT, HTML, EPUB · documents → EPUB · AZW3/MOBI (Kindle) when the free Calibre app is installed
- Comics: CBZ and CBR → PDF, EPUB, CBZ, CBR (with WinRAR) or page images · pictures or a PDF → CBZ
- Spreadsheets ↔ XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV, PDF
- Saves next to the original by default and never overwrites existing files
- ffmpeg is included and the app updates itself when a new version is released

> Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the installer isn't code-signed. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
